title: Prefix machine computes concatenation
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, the finite Turing machine determined by $w$ computes the function sending each Boolean input word $x$ to the concatenation $w \mathbin{++} x$ in time $|w|+|x|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a list of Boolean symbols
